disorder-name.detail: Euthymic bipolar disorder (type I or II) diagnosed by DSM-5 criteria; two BD subgroups (lithium and lithium-naive) merged into one clinical cohort
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Euthymic BD patients (n = 56) and matched healthy controls (n = 26) underwent T1-weighted MRI scans"

dataset-of-origin.detail: BD patients recruited as part of the Bipolar Lithium Imaging and Spectroscopy Study (BLISS); normative model was built from separate public datasets (not the clinical cohort)
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Data were collected as part of the Bipolar Lithium Imaging and Spectroscopy Study (BLISS)."

age.detail: BD group (n=56); min/max from inclusion criteria (18–65 years); mean and SD from Table 1
age.supporting_text: "All participants were 18-65 years of age." Table 1: Age (years) BD group Mean 45.36, SD 12.15 (n=56)

sex.detail: Female n=35 (62%) directly reported in Table 1; male n=21 estimated by subtracting female from total (56−35=21); male_pct calculated as 21/56=37.5%; female_pct calculated as 35/56=62.5% (table reports 62% rounded)
sex.supporting_text: "Sex (n female, % female): n = 35, 62%" (BD group, n=56, Table 1)
